name: Silicon Freckle Remover
description: Silicon Freckle Remover is a specialized cleaning solution based on nitric acid and ammonium fluoride designed to remove silicon freckle defects and surface particulates from semiconductor and flat panel display substrates. Silicon freckles are micro-scale surface defects that form during various fabrication steps and can cause device failure if not removed. This formulation provides controlled chemical action that selectively dissolves silicon-based surface contaminants without damaging the underlying substrate or adjacent thin film layers. The solution is optimized for use in standard wet bench and spray processing equipment in cleanroom environments.
physicalProperties: Appearance: clear liquid; Density: ~1.1-1.2 g/cm³; pH: <2
